name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Blue Dream
description: A true legend in the cannabis world, Blue Dream is a sativa that blends juicy blueberry sweetness with earthy undertones. Known for its uplifting and creative energy, this 2g disposable is crafted to keep your vibe elevated and your mind flowing. Whether you’re tackling a to-do list, diving into a passion project, or just chasing good energy, Blue Dream is the perfect go-to.
